parts.covers: Recorded June 2026 sales for toned milk 500 ml are the evidence base; true demand and lost sales while out of stock are not recorded, so this is not a true-demand estimate.
parts.sql: select sum("daily-sales-june"."units_sold") as "recorded_units", sum("daily-sales-june"."revenue_inr") as "recorded_revenue_inr", count(distinct substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10)) as "days_with_recorded_sales" from "daily-sales-june"  where ("daily-sales-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'MILK-TONED-500ML' and day(daily sales.date) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; report recorded_units = sum of daily sales.units_sold, recorded_revenue_inr = sum of daily sales.revenue_inr, days_with_recorded_sales = count distinct of day(daily sales.date).

parts.covers: On-shelf availability uses the share of 11:00 shelf audits with status 'on shelf'; these twice-weekly snapshots identify recorded empty-shelf evidence but not hours out of stock or demand lost.
parts.sql: select "shelf-audits-june"."status" as "audit_status", count(*) as "audit_count" from "shelf-audits-june"  where ("shelf-audits-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) group by "shelf-audits-june"."status" limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where shelf audits.sku = 'MILK-TONED-500ML' and day(shelf audits.audit_ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by shelf audits.status; report audit_status = shelf audits.status, audit_count = count of *.

parts.covers: The sum of the 28-day-mean recorded-sales forecasts is a labelled stand-in for June demand, not true demand; Rule 4 says forecasts predict demand and cannot be validated against sales alone.
parts.sql: select sum("forecasts-june"."forecast_units_per_day") as "forecast_units_june", count(*) as "forecast_days" from "forecasts-june"  where ("forecasts-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("forecasts-june"."date",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From forecast row records; keep rows where forecasts.sku = 'MILK-TONED-500ML' and day(forecasts.date) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; report forecast_units_june = sum of forecasts.forecast_units_per_day, forecast_days = count of *.

parts.covers: Finds the recorded 11:00 audit snapshots when toned milk was empty; these are snapshots, not continuous hours off the shelf.

parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where shelf audits.sku = 'MILK-TONED-500ML' and shelf audits.status = 'empty'; report empty_audit = shelf audits.audit_ts, empty_day = day(shelf audits.audit_ts); sorted by empty_audit asc.

parts.covers: Ranks the eleven followed products by recorded June sales as evidence for range review; it does not record demand, lost sales, true margins, or products outside these eleven, so it cannot by itself decide additions or delistings.
parts.sql: select "products"."sku" as "sku", "products"."name" as "product_name", sum("daily-sales-june"."units_sold") as "units_sold_june", sum("daily-sales-june"."revenue_inr") as "revenue_inr_june", count(distinct "daily-sales-june"."date") as "days_with_sales" from "daily-sales-june" inner join "products" on "daily-sales-june"."sku" = "products"."sku" group by "products"."sku", "products"."name" order by "units_sold_june" asc limit 200
